kind: gen_input (ABACUS spin-polarized LCAO single-point SCF deck for the L2_1 V2CoAl moments)
provenance: rubric and references from 3_reproduction/L3/ (job 18722313, the HPC cluster); as-run deck at auditor/deck/{INPUT,STRU,KPT}; geometry is L2's relaxed L2_1 CONTCAR

structure_match.note: the STRU must describe the same fixed relaxed L2_1 cell that is staged as POSCAR_relaxed; three distinct species (V/Co/Al), no two-sublattice polarity degeneracy, so StructureMatcher with ElementComparator is safe

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

abacus_required.note: Each rule applies to the effective value: the tag if explicitly set, else the ABACUS default. Only the settings listed here are graded; the per-tag reasoning is in notes.md. Implemented by grader_abacus_inputs (REQUIRED-only, no forbidden/free lists).
abacus_required.scf: SCF, LCAO, nspin2, effective PBE with no U; effective cutoff>=100 Ry; true Mulliken output; exact catalog pseudopotential/orbital identities; automatic Gamma or MP mesh with >=8 per axis; atomwise FM V/Co seed; required structure/species.

score: 1 only if the required run passes all method, effective-PBE/no-U, output, catalog identity, cutoff, k-mesh, effective atomwise magnetic-seed and structure conditions recorded here; unlisted settings are not graded.

effective_defaults.dft_functional: inferred from the separately checked PBE pseudopotentials
effective_defaults.magnetic_seed: mag and magmom are equivalent atomic overrides. For nspin=2 only, all effective atomic moments zero triggers 1.0 on every atom; partial zeros do not.

coordinate_representations: Direct fractional; Cartesian in alat units; Cartesian_au in Bohr; Cartesian_angstrom in Angstrom. Normalize to fractional coordinates for geometry and V sublattice classification.
functional_required: Effective PBE: default/PBE/SLAPWPBXPBC with fixed PBE pseudopotentials; reject a different explicit functional. dft_plus_u remains integer 0.
magnetic_seed_required: Every V and Co has abs(initial moment)>=1e-6; all V/Co same sign, up to global reversal.

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
